context_and_flow.ux_intent: Welcome the new user, obtain consent for email marketing, and direct the user to start training or use a referral code.
ux_patterns: The hero image is a full-width background photo with a dark overlay to ensure readability of the text.
The aesthetic is athletic, community-focused, and premium.
Uses a distinct teal color for the primary CTA button.
Accessibility: text contrast on the background image is managed through an overlay, but readability might be affected by fine details in the photo.
The image serves to humanize the brand and promote a sense of inclusivity.

interaction_elements: Uses a distinct teal color for the primary CTA button.
visual_keywords: Modern mobile UI, dark mode, high-contrast imagery, minimalist layout.
